title: Best-selling video game franchises
prompt: Name the 10 best-selling video game franchises of all time

source.name: Wikipedia: List of best-selling video game franchises

fact.text: Mario's first game was the 1981 arcade game Donkey Kong, two years before Mario Bros.
Its Soviet creator made it in his spare time, programming the first version in about three weeks.
The first games were Pocket Monsters Red and Green in Japan, released abroad as Red and Blue.

answers.name: Call of Duty
aliases: Call of Duty Video Game Series

fact.text: Began as a World War II series; Call of Duty 4 in 2007 moved it to a modern setting.
Started in 1997 at Dundee-based DMA Design, the studio now called Rockstar North.
First released in 2009 by independent designer Markus Persson; Microsoft bought Mojang in 2014.
After a four-year hiatus the name returned in 2026, with games on Roblox and Netflix.
Inspired by Alamut, a novel by Slovenian writer Vladimir Bartol about the medieval Hashashin sect.
Called Biohazard in Japan, its 1996 debut is credited with returning zombies to popular culture.
Its numbered games are volumes, not sequels: each has a story unrelated to the ones before.
